t: Hen Saddle | Chicken Wiki | Fandom
s: October 29, 2024 - A hen saddle is an accessory that is used when feathers on the back and/or wings of a hen become increasingly scarce, due mainly to roosters treading on the hens' backs while breeding. The hen saddle is used to protect any exposed bare skin while giving the feathers time to grow back.
